description.value: Ike's Café was a UBC Food Services–operated café on the UBC Vancouver campus; the URL for this listing now resolves to DaBao, a quick-service outlet specializing in bao, dim sum, tarts, buns, and bubble tea in partnership with Kam Wai Dim Sum, Pine House Bakery, and Pearl Fever. The location sits inside the Irving K. Barber Learning Centre and serves the broader UBC campus community.
